description: Get a curated topic — a person (e.g. "moses", "rambam", "rabbi-akiva"), concept ("teshuvah", "kindness"), holiday ("passover"), mitzvah or object — with its description and its top sources, ordered by importance. Use resolve_name (type "Topic") or search_topics to find slugs.

include_source_text.description: Also fetch the text of the top sources (first 10).

name: get_topic
title: Topic page (sources by theme)
